chat_cases_active_run_complete.name: chat_cases_active_run_complete
chat_cases_active_run_complete.value: ("chat_cases"."active_message_id" IS NULL AND "chat_cases"."active_run_id" IS NULL AND "chat_cases"."active_run_started_at" IS NULL) OR ("chat_cases"."active_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_cases"."active_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_cases"."active_run_started_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_operations_hold_moves_have_autho.name: payment_operations_hold_moves_have_authorization
payment_operations_hold_moves_have_autho.value: "payment_operations"."kind" NOT IN ('capture', 'void', 'reauthorize') OR "payment_operations"."authorization_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_operations_capture_after_supplie.name: payment_operations_capture_after_supplier
payment_operations_capture_after_supplie.value: "payment_operations"."kind" <> 'capture' OR "payment_operations"."change_order_id" IS NULL OR "payment_operations"."supplier_event_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_operations_binding_complete.name: payment_operations_binding_complete
payment_operations_binding_complete.value: ("payment_operations"."change_order_id" IS NULL AND "payment_operations"."revision_id" IS NULL AND "payment_operations"."content_hash" IS NULL AND "payment_operations"."revision_content_hash" IS NULL) OR ("payment_operations"."change_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_operations"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_operations"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_operations"."revision_content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_operations"."item_id" IS NOT NULL)

supplier_events_terms.name: supplier_events_terms
supplier_events_terms.value:
("supplier_events"."kind" = 'order_confirmed' AND "supplier_events"."quantity" >= 1 AND "supplier_events"."unit_price_cents" >= 0 AND "supplier_events"."tax_cents" >= 0 AND "supplier_events"."freight_cents" >= 0 AND "supplier_events"."in_stock" IS TRUE AND "supplier_events"."total_cents" = "supplier_events"."quantity" * "supplier_events"."unit_price_cents" + "supplier_events"."tax_cents" + "supplier_events"."freight_cents")
      OR ("supplier_events"."kind" = 'credit_confirmed' AND "supplier_events"."quantity" IS NULL AND "supplier_events"."unit_price_cents" IS NULL AND "supplier_events"."tax_cents" IS NULL AND "supplier_events"."freight_cents" IS NULL AND "supplier_events"."in_stock" IS NULL)
